records.text: An unnamed source told Owens that the Trump administration was trying to make FOIA requests more difficult and keep documents classified for a period of time.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #1 (Ep 3QJqtW_NOSI)

appearances.snippet: And from what I am told, they are trying to make it more difficult for people to FOIA requests to be able to hold these documents as classified for a period of time.

conveyance.original_source: Private communication described by Candace Owens
